crossRefs.note: All the people who were in the gate, and the elders, said, “We are witnesses. May Yahweh make the woman who has come…
Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.
Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.
Laban gave Bilhah, his servant, to his daughter Rachel to be her servant.

people.name: Leah
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of six sons and Dinah

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

translations.web: Rachel and Leah answered him, “Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?
translations.bsb: And Rachel and Leah replied, “Do we have any portion or inheritance left in our father’s house?
translations.kjv: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?
translations.asv: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?
